metadata.title: feat(runtime): secure MCP runtime deployment and catalog integration (IBM Cloud and Code Engine)
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description: > **Note:** This PR was re-created from #2994 due to repository maintenance. Your code and branch are intact. @crivetimihai please verify everything looks good. ## Summary - implement secure MCP runtime orchestration with guarded deployment approvals and runtime lifecycle APIs - add runtime database models and migration, runtime service/router/schemas, and Docker + IBM Code Engine backend adapters - integrate runtime-aware catalog metadata and admin catalog filtering/visibility updates - expose runtime feature flags and settings through config surfaces (.env.example, docker-compose, Helm values/schema, docs config schema) - document runtime operations and architecture with manage docs updates and ADR 041 - add unit tests for runtime service/router/schemas and keep diff coverage at 100% for the new Python diff Closes #2110
